title: First instruction at a code position
statement: Let $P$ be a list of instructions, and suppose the list beginning at position $\mathrm{pos}$ has $i$ as its first instruction. Then the instruction at position $\mathrm{pos}$ in $P$ is $i$; when that position is beyond the end of $P$, the instruction there is taken to be reject.
hypotheses_covered: The list beginning at position $\mathrm{pos}$ has $i$ prepended to some list $l$
